name: Barilla Classic White Semolina Spaghetti (Cooked Tender)
whyItWorks: 100% durum wheat semolina with the outer bran polished off. When boiled tender, white pasta is an elite flare-safe carb: simple, low-residue, non-bloating, and easy to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil in salted water for 9–10 minutes until tender (cook slightly past al dente during acute inflammation for softer chewing). Toss with butter or light olive oil.
watchOuts: Never choose whole wheat pasta during flares; whole wheat pasta has coarse insoluble bran.
